image.background: a soft pale warm wall (#FAF7F2) with a simple floor line across the bottom
image.style: friendly flat vector illustration, straight-on side view, soft cel shading, warm muted palette, no photorealism, no text of any kind
image.overall: A wooden step ladder standing against a pale wall, seen straight on, filling most of the frame height. The ladder has TWO vertical side rails in natural light wood and exactly SIX evenly spaced horizontal rungs. Each rung is painted a different solid colour, from bottom to top: rung 1 blue (#4A90D9), rung 2 amber (#F5A623), rung 3 orange (#E67E22), rung 4 mint green (#7ED6A5), rung 5 violet (#9B59B6), rung 6 teal (#16A085). Resting on top of each rung, centred, is one small simple object, each drawn as a clean flat icon-like shape with no lettering on it: on rung 1 a rectangular index card; on rung 2 a circular badge with a small star shape in the middle; on rung 3 a small sheet of round stickers shown as a rectangle with several small circles on it; on rung 4 a folded map with a dotted route line and a small pin; on rung 5 a small grid poster shown as a rectangle divided into squares, several of them filled in; on rung 6 a rolled certificate scroll tied with a ribbon and a small rosette. The ladder should be drawn so all six rungs and all six objects are clearly visible and well separated.
image.layoutNotes: Space the six rungs evenly with generous vertical gaps so each object sits clearly on its own rung with breathing room above and below. Centre the ladder horizontally with at least 15% clear wall on the left and right. The bottom rung should sit at roughly 84% from the top and the top rung at roughly 14% from the top, with the four middle rungs evenly distributed between them. Do not draw any text, letters, numbers, or writing on any object -- especially not on the certificate, the poster, or the card. Do not draw people or hands. Keep the wall plain.

callouts.label: Challenge Card System
callouts.hint: The object on the lowest rung.
callouts.description: Marks choosing and starting a single challenge; the entry point of the whole ladder.

draw.position: On the bottom rung, about 50% from the left and 84% from the top.
draw.visual: A plain rectangular index card resting on the blue bottom rung, with faint blank ruled lines and no writing.

callouts.label: Badge Design
callouts.hint: The round object on the second rung.
callouts.description: Marks one specific skill demonstrated and explained, named after exactly what it proves.

draw.position: On the second rung from the bottom, about 50% from the left and 70% from the top.
draw.visual: A circular enamel-style badge with a scalloped edge and a small star shape in its centre, resting on the amber rung. No lettering.

callouts.label: Sticker Reward System
callouts.hint: The sheet of small circles on the third rung.
callouts.description: Marks a small, immediate moment of progress, reserved for real completions rather than every attempt.

draw.position: On the third rung, about 50% from the left and 56% from the top.
draw.visual: A small rectangular sheet with six or eight round stickers on it in assorted colours, one corner slightly peeled up, resting on the orange rung. No lettering.

callouts.label: Learning Map Display
callouts.hint: The folded paper with a route on it, on the fourth rung.
callouts.description: Marks a student's growing personal path, visible to them without ranking them against peers.

draw.position: On the fourth rung, about 50% from the left and 42% from the top.
draw.visual: A partly folded map with a meandering dotted route line across it and a small round location pin near one end, resting on the mint green rung. No place names or lettering.

callouts.label: Progress Tracker Poster
callouts.hint: The grid of squares on the fifth rung.
callouts.description: Marks the whole club's shared momentum, one filled square at a time.

draw.position: On the fifth rung, about 50% from the left and 28% from the top.
draw.visual: A small poster shown as a rectangle divided into a grid of about twenty squares, roughly two thirds of them filled in with solid colour and the rest left blank, resting on the violet rung. No lettering.

callouts.label: Certificate Of Completion
callouts.hint: The ribboned scroll on the top rung.
callouts.description: Marks an entire track finished -- the largest, least frequent reward on the ladder.

draw.position: On the top rung, about 50% from the left and 14% from the top.
draw.visual: A cream certificate with a decorative border, partly rolled, tied with a ribbon, with a small circular rosette and two ribbon tails at one corner, resting on the teal top rung. No lettering anywhere on it.
